sentiment.rationale: The document reports record operating profit and margin, but forward guidance for Q2 paid net additions is very low (1m vs 10m a year ago), and FY21 operating margin target of 20% is unchanged. Management attributes the membership miss to COVID pull-forward and a lighter content slate, and expects re-acceleration in H2. The overall tone is optimistic but the near-term guidance is weak, resulting in a mildly positive score reflecting the unchanged long-term target and confident H2 outlook, offset by the soft Q2 forecast.

summary.revenue: Revenue grew 24% year over year to $7,163 million in Q1'21, in line with forecast.
summary.eps: Diluted EPS was $3.75 vs. $1.57 a year ago, including a $253m non-cash unrealized gain from F/X remeasurement on Euro denominated debt.
summary.guidance: Q2'21 forecast: revenue $7,302 million, operating income $1,865 million, operating margin 25.5%, diluted EPS $3.16, paid net additions of 1 million. FY21 operating margin target unchanged at 20%.
summary.margin: Operating margin reached an all-time high of 27.4% in Q1'21, up from 16.6% a year ago. Q2'21 forecast operating margin 25.5%.
key_risks: Paid membership growth slowed due to COVID-19 pull forward in 2020 and a lighter content slate in H1 2021 due to production delays.
Q1 paid net additions of 4m were below guidance of 6m.
Q2 paid net additions forecast of 1m is very low vs. 10m in prior year quarter.
Uncertainty from COVID-19 in the short-term.
Production delays from COVID-19 continue to affect content slate.
Vaccine rollout is uneven across the world; not yet producing in Brazil and India.
key_opportunities: Strong second half anticipated with return of big hits (Sex Education, The Witcher, Money Heist, You) and an exciting film lineup.
Engagement per member household grew solidly year over year in Q1'21.
Q1'21 churn below Q1'20 levels, demonstrating ability to charge more.
Rise of streaming to replace linear TV around the world is a clear long-term trend.
Believe they are still in early days of internet entertainment adoption, providing many years of growth.
Board approved $5 billion stock repurchase program beginning in 2021.
Free cash flow positive in Q1 and on track for full year 2021 FCF to be approximately break even; no longer need external financing.

management_tone.label: optimistic
management_tone.justification: Management states 'We are optimistic about the future and believe we are still in the early days of the adoption of internet entertainment' and describes a 'very strong back half slate'.
